title: Exploring the severity and risk factors of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease using the SAF scoring system.
authors: Li X, Wang S, Zhang Z, Deng W, Zhang Y, Cao W, Wei X, Gao Z, Yao L, Wang S, Yi W, Xie Y, Li M.
